subject: Opt-out confirmation for model tuning; logging & residency checklist
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Singh <anita@novahealth.io>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@mountaincloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap: data handling commitments and next steps

Hi Anita / Alex — thanks for taking the time earlier. Quick recap and the asks we captured on the call so we can move to contract/config: 

What NovaHealth requested (confirming):
- No customer data is used for model training or any model improvement workflows (full opt-out).
- PII redaction at ingestion where practical (they will flag high-risk fields we should mask).
- Log retention: reduce request logs to 7 days and retain only metadata for 90 days for debugging / audit (no raw request bodies beyond 7 days).
- Data residency: tenant will be pinned to US-East region; no cross-region replication.
- Encryption: customer prefers BYOK (bring-your-own-key) for ciphertext at rest.

Action items from Redwood: 
- Provide a short Data Handling Addendum documenting the opt-out and retention commitments (attached as a first draft).
- Confirm configuration steps and expected timeline to enforce 7-day/raw-data purge and US-East pinning.
- Share SOC 2 / security summary for procurement.

Next steps: 
1) Anita — please confirm the above bullet list and share the legal contact for sign-off (you mentioned Priya Desai on the call).
2) We'll route the addendum to Legal (Marissa) and Sales Ops (Ben) for signature and technical onboarding.

Attaching: Data_Handling_Addendum_v1.pdf (draft for review).

If that all looks right I’ll kick off the configuration change once we have the signed addendum.

Thanks,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
+1 (555) 482-0912

Attachment: Data_Handling_Addendum_v1.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)

From: Anita Singh <anita@novahealth.io>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@mountaincloud.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: data handling commitments and next steps

Hi Rafael — thanks for the clear recap. Correct on everything with a couple of clarifications and a small request from Legal/Engineering: 

Clarifications / requests:
- Confirmed: NovaHealth requires a full opt-out for model training/model-improvement pipelines. No training or supervised fine-tuning with customer content.
- PII handling: We will provide a list of high-risk fields (SSN, full DOB, patient ID) that must be redacted at ingestion. Where redaction cannot be done upstream, we need an automatic token masking policy in logs.
- Log retention: 7 days for raw request/response contents; anonymized metadata (request id, model version, token counts, error codes) can be kept up to 90 days for incident investigation.
- BYOK: We would like to leverage our KMS key for tenant-at-rest encryption; please confirm whether that is supported and any integration steps.

Legal contact for signatures: Priya Desai, Counsel <priya@novahealth.io>. 

Also can you include your SOC 2 or equivalent summary for our procurement team? That will speed approvals.

Thanks — we’re happy to move quickly once the addendum is in place and we have the technical plan.

—Anita
Anita Singh
Head of Product, NovaHealth
anita@novahealth.io

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: data handling commitments and next steps

Hi Anita / Priya — appreciate the fast confirmation. Per your asks, we will: 

1) Treat NovaHealth as opted out of any training/model-improvement workflows. We will append an explicit clause to the DPA/Addendum: "Customer data will not be used for model training or model improvement."
2) Implement a log retention policy: raw request/response bodies will be purged after 7 days; metadata (redacted) retained 90 days for ops/audit.
3) Pin the tenant to US-East (no cross-region replication for customer data).
4) Start BYOK onboarding once we receive a KMS thumbprint from your team — we support standard KMS provider integrations; attaching a short integration guide.

Attachments included: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC 2 report summary), BYOK-integration-guidance.md (implementation notes).

Next steps / timing:
- Legal review: Marissa (cc’d) will accept redlines or push a final version; if there are no material changes, we can finalize the addendum within 3 business days.
- Tech onboarding: Once addendum signed and we have the KMS info, infra will schedule a tenant cutover window to enforce 7-day purge (estimated 2 business days of work).

Anita/Priya — can you confirm the legal email is correct and whether we have permission to share our SOC 2 summary with your procurement team? Also, would NovaHealth like Redwood to be listed as a reference/customer on our site?

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Exec — Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)
Attachment: BYOK-integration-guidance.md (Markdown, 6 KB)

- Ben: please flag billing for any onboarding professional services (BYOK setup + residency pinning) — estimate 4-8 hours escalation to SRE.
